description: Search for Google spreadsheets accessible in Drive by name, content, dates, and other filters, including starred and shared-with-me status. Results are paginated, with up to 1,000 items per page; shared drives are included by default and searches across them may be incomplete.

query.title: Query
query.description: Search query to filter spreadsheets. Behavior depends on the 'search_type' parameter. For advanced searches, use Google Drive query syntax with fields like 'name contains', 'fullText contains', or boolean filters like 'sharedWithMe = true'. DO NOT use spreadsheet IDs as search terms. Leave empty to get all spreadsheets.

order_by.title: Order By
order_by.description: Sort order (comma-separated list for multi-field sorting). Valid fields: createdTime, folder, modifiedByMeTime, modifiedTime, name, name_natural, quotaBytesUsed, recency, sharedWithMeTime, starred, viewedByMeTime. Append ' desc' for descending order (default is ascending). Examples: 'modifiedTime desc', 'folder,name', 'starred,modifiedTime desc'.

page_token.title: Page Token
page_token.description: Token for retrieving the next page of results. Use the 'next_page_token' value from a previous response to get subsequent pages. Leave empty to get the first page.
page_token.human_parameter_description: Token for retrieving the next page of results from a previous search.

max_results.title: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of spreadsheets to return (1-1000). Defaults to 10.
max_results.human_parameter_description: Maximum number of spreadsheets to return (1-1000). Defaults to 10.

search_type.title: Search Type
search_type.description: How to search: 'name' searches filenames only (prefix matching from the START of filenames), 'content' uses fullText search which searches file content, name, description, and metadata (Google Drive API limitation: cannot search content exclusively without also matching filenames), 'both' explicitly searches both name OR content with an OR condition. Note: 'name' search only matches from the START of filenames (e.g., 'Budget' finds 'Budget 2024' but NOT 'Q1 Budget').
search_type.human_parameter_description: How to search: 'name' for filenames, 'content' for file content/metadata, 'both' for either.

starred_only.title: Starred Only
starred_only.description: Whether to return only starred spreadsheets. Defaults to False.
starred_only.human_parameter_description: Whether to return only starred spreadsheets. Defaults to False.

created_after.title: Created After
created_after.description: Return spreadsheets created after this date. Use RFC 3339 format like '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'.
created_after.human_parameter_description: Return spreadsheets created after this date. Use RFC 3339 format like

modified_after.title: Modified After
modified_after.description: Return spreadsheets modified after this date. Use RFC 3339 format like '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'.
modified_after.human_parameter_description: Return spreadsheets modified after this date. Use RFC 3339 format like

shared_with_me.title: Shared With Me
shared_with_me.description: Whether to return only spreadsheets shared with the current user. Defaults to False.
shared_with_me.human_parameter_description: Whether to return only spreadsheets shared with the current user. Defaults to False.

include_trashed.title: Include Trashed
include_trashed.description: Whether to include spreadsheets in trash. Defaults to False.
include_trashed.human_parameter_description: Whether to include spreadsheets in trash. Defaults to False.

include_shared_drives.title: Include Shared Drives
include_shared_drives.description: Whether to include spreadsheets from shared drives you have access to. Defaults to True.
include_shared_drives.human_parameter_description: Include spreadsheets from shared drives (team drives) you have access to in the search results.

display_url.title: Display Url
display_url.description: Direct link to view this spreadsheet in Google Sheets web interface.

display_url.title: Display Url
display_url.description: No collection-level UI page for search results; only per-item URLs are meaningful.

total_found.title: Total Found
total_found.description: Number of spreadsheet items returned in this response page.

spreadsheets.title: Spreadsheets
spreadsheets.description: List of matching spreadsheets accessible to the authenticated user.

search_message.title: Search Message
search_message.description: Informational message about the search results, including suggestions when no results are found.

next_page_token.title: Next Page Token
next_page_token.description: Opaque token to retrieve the next page of results. Null indicates there are no additional pages.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not
